notes.title: Carrier Adjustment
notes.content:
[h1]Server Adjustments[/h1]

Dear players: 

We are sincerely sorry to announce the following server adjustments: 

Current server: Asia Server 2 and 8 will be closing on December 21.
Current servers: Asia Server 7, Asia Server 9 and Asia Server 10 will be preserved until February 23, 2023. 
Current servers: Europe Server and America Server will be adjusted into international servers that can be accessed from both mobile and pc devices in December, 2022. 
After February 23, we will reset all servers to allow access from both mobile and pc. 


[h1]December Optimization Update Announcement[/h1]

Thank you for your support and patience with Zero-based World! First of all, we would like to apologize for recent delay in game updates. In this update, we are applying the changes and adjustments we had made in Android testing versions to Steam version, preparing for opening up new servers that allow data interworking. 

In June 2022, we started Android testing in Southeast Asia region. Since we started testing, we had made multiple adjustment towards game optimization, novice guide, and task-related recipes. In this update, these adjustments will be applied to current version: 
[list]
[*] Graphic display
[*] Footstep sounds
[*] Spear attack sound
[*] Quest notification sounds
[*] Quest-related object recipe
[*] New novice weapon: Simple Bola. Simple Bola can be crafted by grass and stone, and can be thrown out at small creatures to knock them out by press and hold attack. 
[*] New 2D animations: 5 new animations are added to guide new players go through novice tasks. 
[*] New NPCs: 3 new NPCs are added to the game. Players can interact with them for some game tips. More NPC-related functions will be added in the future. 
[/list]

In the following months, we will work on developing server interworking. New servers are expected to be available in early 2023. In new servers, players from either Android devices or Steam platform are able to enjoy the game together. 

In the past 6 months, we spent most of the time on optimizing the game’s Android version, and the update for Steam version had been delayed and we sincerely apologize for the delay. Once the new servers are ready, we will continue creating new game contents, game events, and bring better game experience to players in 2023. 


Thank you all! 


Zero-based World Development Team

notes.title: 6.2 Major Update
notes.content:
This summer event update was put off for a month due to local covid policies, and we would like to sincerely apologize for all players for the delay in this update. 

As summer coming, the New Spring Event would come to an end. Meanwhile, the brand-new Midsummer Event is now available in game for players. During Midsummer Event, players are able to plant event flowers to collect sunlight, draw random rewards, and get new plant companions. 

New content in store: The in-game store was now updated! New Midsummer packs are now available as well as two different building structure packs! Now players can purchase crystal building structures and composite building structures in store. 

In this update, we also adjusted the health and attack values of rune creatures and elemental creatures, increased the max level for several weapons, and fixed existing bugs in last version. 

[h1]Summer Event: The Midsummer Festival[/h1]

[h2]The Scorching Sun: [/h2]

Summer arrived in Dream Land, and the dormant sunflowers begin to bloom. During summer event, players would find Dwarf Sunflowers scattered over the Dream Land. By interacting with the Dwarf Sunflowers, players can randomly get Sunlight or Unstable Seeds. Use them to grow flowers that produce more Sunlight. Craft event flowerpots and event limited fertilizers to expand your planting scale, collect more Sunlight for follow-up activities!

[h2]Gameplay experience: [/h2]

3.	Changed required material for crafting Arrows, Poisonous Arrows from Wood to Branches. 
4.	The Spicy Strip can now be used to tame herbivores and omnivores. 
5.	Silver Spicy Strip can now be equipped as weapon. 
6.	Changed the distribution of Carrots to underground. Eating Carrots provides cold resistance to the character. 
7.	Changed the distribution of Mushrooms to the Mud Area. 
8.	Changed the temperature in grassland, make sure new players won’t get hypothermia from night rains. 
9.	Player behaviors in the early stage of gameplay will no longer consume water. 

[h2]Recipe Adjusted: [/h2]

5.	Fixed the bug of creature flickering when dismounted. 
6.	Fixed the bug that creatures might move around with sleeping gestures. 
7.	Fixed multiple display bugs. 
8.	Now picking up animals will not trigger the death animation of the animal. 
9.	Corrected the displayed time in Team interface. 
10.	Fixed the bug that facilities would sometimes stop producing products. 
11.	Greatly increased the speed of loading landscapes and buildings. 
12.	Corrected the rare product of crops from Silver Spicy Strip to Fruit of Knowledge. 
13.	Increased the frame rate. 

[h1]Forecast on future updates: [/h1]

In the future update, we will continue optimize game content and game experience. The development of our game for mobile devices is now close to completion, and already started testing in some regions on Google Play.

[list]
[*]Giant Sheep is now able to produce heat. Players can now keep themselves warm by staying close to the Giant Sheep. 
[*]Players can now exchange items with Giant Penguins. Building structures, weapons and equipment can all be dragged into the inventory of Giant Penguin to exchange for resources. 
[*]Giant Squirrels can now perform ranged attacks when mounted. 
[*]Giant Rabbits can now knock other creatures out with their kicks. 
[/list]

[h2]Attribute Adjustment: [/h2]
[list]
[*]The attribute Poison now causes both damage and sanity loss. When hit by poisonous attacks there will be special visual effects. 
[*]Adjusted the anima cost, health and attack values for pocket-size creatures and giant creatures. 
[*]Adjusted the distribution of creatures in Snowlands. 
[/list]

1.	Removed the attribute bars on the upper-left corner of the screen. Character’s health and thirst will be displayed above character’s head, when fully recovered they will become invisible. 
2.	Added descriptions for splitting and discarding items. 
3.	Decreased the vibration of icons when opening up memory menu. Now players can check memory menu faster. 
4.	Changed the formatting of some descriptions. 
5.	Slightly adjusted the size of names of interactive devices. 
6.	Removed the countdowns on items when the item is used up. 
7.	The UI of locking camera on enemies is now translucent. 

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
1.	Decreased the probability for trees to drop Tree Sap. The Tree Sap in recipe of Storage Boxes are changed to Huge Leaf. 
2.	Added a new recipe for workbenches. Players can now use Huge Leaves to craft more Ropes in workbenches. 
3.	Removed some abandoned memories. 
4.	Greatly reduced the production time for Rope, Stone Ash, Flour and Chemical Fertilizer. 
5.	Wooden Amulet’s durability won’t drop automatically now. 
6.	Now roasted food, Bread and Jumbo Burger provide more heat for the character. 
7.	The precondition of unlocking Sloping Ceilings are now Walls. 
8.	The precondition of unlocking Iron Gate is now Blacksmith Workbench. 
9.	The stack number of Poached Eggs is now 10. 
10.	Large creatures can now equip head gears and body gears. 
11.	Reduced the charcoal from the loots of Branches. 
12.	Greatly increased the bonus speed provided by Carrot Stick. 
13.	Wooden Wild Boar Armor and Clay Pot now require one extra mucus to be crafted. 
14.	Increased the health value of Spiders. 
15.	Decreased the required amount of Linen Fiber for crafting Pelt Clothes. 
16.	The ingredients of Monster Vegetable Stew are changed to Strange Meat, Durian Flesh and Roasted Mushrooms. It’s now the most efficient food for taming scavengers. 
17.	Increased the sanity loss caused by poisonous attacks. 
18.	Removed Premium Wood from the recipe of Yak Saddle. 
19.	Removed the Imagination cost for basic straw buildings and some wooden buildings. 
20.	The durability of Eggplant in Clay Pot and Milk are now increased to 8000. 
21.	Rope is now required for crafting Coconut Flask. 
22.	Replaced Premium Wood with Wood from the recipes of Iron Axe and Iron Pickaxe. 
23.	Increased the sanity recover value of Soda. 
24.	Replaced wool with Linen Fiber in the recipe of Feather outfits. 
25.	Changed the ingredients required for Delicious Meat Broth. 

[h2]Optimization & Bugs Fixed: [/h2]
1.	Changed the icon of Will in the Seed of Heart. 
2.	Corrected the probability of dropping Dragon Fruits when chopping down Cactus. 
3.	Fixed the bug of hatched creatures not belonging to players. 
4.	Fixed the bug of losing hatched creatures when sending them to Utopias. 

[h2]Follow-up Update notice: [/h2]
We will continue optimizing the detailed game experience in our following updates. Released creatures will have more skills and functions to help players with their exploration. Also, we are now working on developing functions including changing character names and starting new game, which will be completed within a short period.

notes.title: 3.8 Optimization Update
notes.content:
[h2]The New Spring Event: Upgrading the Nian Beast[/h2]
We adjusted the growth of the Nian Beasts. 
New creatures: 
1.	Crystal Nian Beast
2.	Auspicious Nian Beast
New item: Fantasy Nian beast's Egg
Crystal Nian Beast and Auspicious Nian Beast are new rare Nian beasts that look like Mini Nian Beasts. They can’t be released in Nian Beast Altar, but as resources for releasing Nian Beasts, exiling them gives players a large amount of Anima. 
Decreased the required amount of Nian Beasts for releasing Nian Beasts and Ice Nian Beasts. Higher level Nian Beasts now require Crystal Nian Beasts and Auspicious Nian Beasts to release to next stage. 
The Crystal Nian Beast and Auspicious Nian Beast can be hatched from all kinds of Nian’s Eggs with low possibility. 
The Fantasy Nian Beast’s Egg is a rare loot of the King of Nian Beasts and only hatch Crystal Nian Beasts or Auspicious Nian Beasts. 
Slightly increased the possibility for the King of Nian Beast to drop Ice Nian Beast’s Egg. 
Decreased the Anima cost for upgrading Nian Beasts. 
Note: There’s no adjustments on the difficulty of releasing a Nian Beast in this update. 
[h3]Environment Adjustments: [/h3]
We added some decorative trees to the Grassland. 
Removed the Blood-sucking Mosquitos at the edges of the desert: now they only spawn deep in the desert. 
[h3]New Equipment:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/1a4eda7f70bba6bf9606b007bca823781501f7c7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/b52cb1b31fb251e6e89a54c08b10c7904074db7c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/5fb5bce81e67883d50b2032b334c152a600f0776.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/c6e9c2a037f4e4dfc957f53d1fc8e690f5029763.png[/img][/url]
Linen Clothes: Cooling outfit with resistance to poison. 
Linen Hat: Cooling hat with resistance to poison.
[h3]Guidance Optimization:[/h3]
We added quest descriptions on the main interface to help players understand the quests better. 
Some guidance has been moved to the bottom-left of the main interface as hints, instead of popping up. 
Adjusted lots of guidance contents to fit the new game experience. 
Optimized some item descriptions. 
[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
1.	Adjusted the skills of Boars and Wolves, they now move more naturally. 
2.	Strengthened the charged attack of the Pike. Now the charging time is longer and characters can move when charging. 
3.	Changed the way players acquire wools. Wools are no longer loots of Sheep, instead they become outcomes when feeding tamed sheep. 
4.	Increased the food types of Colorful Birds and Yaks. Now all crops can be fed to them to produce eggs or milk. 
5.	Changed the recipe of Roast Nuts. Now all seeds can be baked into Roast Nuts except for Pineapple Seeds. 
6.	Removed the durability lost of the Memory Bracelet when attacking creatures. Now its durability only drops when character respawns. 
7.	Adjusted the sound of Boars and Moose. 
8.	To throw rocks, players now need to press and hold attack. One click would result in character kicking forward. 
9.	The sanity attribute is now changed into dizziness and it’s 0 by default. Satiety is changed into cold hardiness. 
10.	Ropes are not required for Pikes, Straw Tents and Straw Clothes. 
11.	The Eggplant Seeds are no longer loots of rabbits. They can now be found in Tall Grasses. 
12.	Added captions to the game start animation. 
13.	Character’s inventory list would be opened when interacting with production facilities. 
14.	The character now eats food faster. 
15.	Increased the durability of straw products and stone weapons. 
16.	Adjusted the attack values of creatures. 
17.	Adjusted some attack and defense values of the equipment and weapons. 
18.	Increased the attack value of the Nian Beasts. 
19.	Adjusted creature’s attribute values in Utopia. 
20.	Now characters and creatures can switch between walking/running by clicking shift. 
[h2]Optimization & Bugs Fixed[/h2]
1.	Fixed the movements when dodging with clubs. Now it won’t be interrupted. 
2.	Repaired the problem of frequent loading. 
3.	Fixed the bug that animals would sometimes freeze during combats. 
4.	Fixed the bug that players can’t change their weapon sometimes. 
5.	Fixed the memory bugs when changing characters. 
6.	Fixed the bug that some facilities would stop working during production. 
7.	Repaired the Utopia animation. 
8.	Fixed the bug that players can’t craft items with Quick Access bar. 
9.	Repaired the auto-clip for building structures. 
10.	Fixed the bug that players in the same team would sometimes be recognized as enemies. 
11.	The Character can now perform some movements during jumps. 
12.	Increased the frame rate.
[h2]Follow-up Update notice: [/h2]
We will continue optimizing the detailed game experience, decrease the latency caused by building structures and facilities. We are now trying to adjust the attack and defense values of all creatures, hoping to have a better positioning for different creatures and weapons.

notes.title: 1.30 Spring Update
notes.content:
At the beginning of 2022, our new Spring update is released. 
This update mainly carries our Spring special events, in which players can challenge the fierce beasts only show up in early spring. 
Newly added in-game store. Now players can purchase basic materials, eggs and special-event-limited materials. 

[h1]Spring Event: The Nian Beast[/h1]
The theme of our Spring event in the beginning of this new year is the Nian beast. 
Note: This event would be longer and last for the whole season. There’s no need to worry and just play at your own pace! 
[h3]Anomalies on the Land: [/h3]
During Spring event, mysterious creatures appeared in this Dream Land. 
These creatures include Nian beasts with burning flames, cute mini Nian beasts and invincible boss: the King of Nian beasts. 
Mini Nian beast: Cute cubs of the Nian beast that appear randomly in the Dream Land. These puny creatures can only run away from you when being attacked. Defeating a mini Nian beast gives you one Memory of Spring. 
Nian beast: Powerful creatures that sporadically appear in the world with blazes burning on their bodies. Nian beasts are neutral creatures, their attacks cause fire damage and is hard to defend. They move slowly but have high defense, can only be effectively harmed by attacks of special weapons in Spring event. Defeating Nian beasts gives you 3 Memory of Spring, Horn of Nian beast, Fire Element and Sulfur. 
The King of Nian beasts: Powerful boss creature appears in early spring. One stays in Dreamland while the other is in the Oasis in desert. It would be extremely hard to challenge the King of Nian beasts and players will need higher-level special equipment, weapons and teammates. The King of Nian beasts would gradually drop Memory of Spring and Horn of Nian beast when its health drops. Players can find precious Nian beast’s Eggs after defeating the King of Nian beasts. By using Nian beast’s Egg, players can hatch their own Nian beasts. 
Note: All Nian beasts in the wild cannot be tamed. 
[h3]Preparation for the spring: [/h3]
To prepare for the challenges in Spring event, there are some special contents added in this event. 
Special contents: 
1.	Memory of Spring: The basic memory of Spring event, provides memories of special weapons and food. It’s also the basic material for crafting other Spring event items. Can be converted into a bit anima in Nian Beast Altar. 
2.	Horn of Nian Beast: The horn of Nian beast, material for crafting Spring event equipment. Can be converted into a large amount of anima in Nian Beast Altar. 
3.	Spring Potage: Special food in Spring event, requires Memory of Spring to cook. Provides advanced memories in Spring event. By consuming Spring Potage, players can get multiple advanced memories. 
4.	Water Dragon Mace: Special weapon in Spring event that performs water elemental attacks. Quite effective for Nian beasts. 
5.	Water Dragon Cannon: Special weapon in Spring event that performs water elemental attacks. Less dangerous that the rocket launchers but effective for Nian beasts. 
6.	Nian Outfit: Special festive equipment in Spring event, greatly enhances player’s fire resistance. Effective armor for defending attacks from Nian beast. Players can acquire its memory by consuming Spring Potage. 
7.	Nian Hat: Special festive equipment in Spring event, greatly enhances player’s fire resistance. Effective armor for defending attacks from Nian beast. Players can acquire its memory by consuming Spring Potage. 
8.	Nian Beast’s Egg: Precious reward for defeating the King of Nian beasts. Can be hatched into tamed Nian beasts. 
9.	Ice Nian Beast’s Egg: Rare reward for defeating the King of Nian beasts. Can be hatched into tamed Ice Nian beasts. 
10.	Nian Beast Altar: The Altar for your hatched Nian beasts, which could also be considered as the Utopia for Nian beasts. Players can convert Memory of Spring and Horn of Nian beast into anima within it and upgrade their Nian beasts, eventually merging them into Giant Nian beasts and the King of Glacier. Players can acquire its memory by consuming Spring Potage. 
11.	Nian Beast Saddle: The saddle for Nian beasts, players can acquire its memory by consuming Spring Potage. 
12.	Giant Nian Beast Saddle: The saddle for Giant Nian beasts, players can acquire its memory by consuming Spring Potage. 
13.	Ice Nian Beast Saddle: The saddle for Ice Nian beasts, players can acquire its memory by consuming Spring Potage. 
14.	The King of Glacier Saddle: The saddle for the King of Glaciers, players can acquire its memory by consuming Spring Potage.

Arm yourself with advanced equipment, challenge the King of Nian beasts to hatch your own Nian beast. Build the Nian Beast Altar and raise your Nian beasts to finally get Giant Nian beast and mysterious King of Glacier. 
[h3]Power of Nian Beasts: [/h3]
Except for Nian beasts appear in the wild, there are other types of Nian beasts hatched from Nian beast’s Eggs, or merged in Nian Beast Altars. 
Ice Nian Beast: There’s a small probability that players could acquire an Ice Nian beast Egg when defeating the King of Nian Beasts, which can be hatched into Ice Nian beasts by Incubator or Large Incubator. Ice Nian beasts’ attack causes ice elemental damage. Ice elemental attacks causes extra damage to Nian beasts, but Ice Nian beasts is also weak to fire elemental damage. 
Giant Nian Beast: By converting Memory of Spring and Horn of Nian beast into anima in Nian Beast Altar, you can upgrade and merge Nian beasts to eventually get a Giant Nian beast with its true power released. 
The King of Glacier: Rare creature merged by Ice Nian beasts, causes massive ice elemental damage.

notes.title: 1.17 Major Update
notes.content:
There have been a few days since the update in test servers and here comes the update announcement. In this version, a new content is added: The Mirror of Heart. It allows players to improve the power of characters to fight the monsters in this dream world. 
We re-designed the user interface, simplified the operations for better visual effect, and adjusted the definition and effects of the basic character attributes. 
Meantime, we re-organized the game process, structures of production and the effects of foods, to decrease the difficulties in daily activities. 
The quest sequence is adjusted. 
Besides, we also fixed some bugs and problems noticed in previous version. 
[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Content: Seed of Heart[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Seed of Heart[/h3]
A new content is added: The Seed of Heart. 
When entering the game, players will get a default Seed of Heart: Seed of Lake. It can be seen on the right side of character’s health bar or in the Seed of Heart section in main menu. 
The Seed of Heart will slowly grow when equipped. Check your Seed periodically and it would eventually grow into the Flower of Lake. Then players are able to release the true power within it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/d929b68cfd3fc2640edbbf45053f7ac1361fd770.jpg[/img]
New players can have the memory of the Mirror of Heart by finishing quests. For previous players that already spent some time playing the game, a gift code: 418A5470 is offered to exchange for the memory. 
[code][h2][u][b]418A5470[/b][/u][/h2][/code]
Craft a Mirror of Heart, then you will be able to examine your Seed of Heart in it. Put your Flower of Lake into the Mirror of Heart, update it with your Imagination and turn it into the Heart of Lake. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/a8ecb5299d43a9b26cf2f0cabe94b092af99527a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/a28e09b94a1d01c34844ecb6bb895fa1cf18c109.png[/img]
The Heart of Lake can slowly heal you by consuming water. By updating the Heart of Lake, the water consumption can be reduced. The healing speed can also be improved when the Heart of Lake is upgraded to a certain level. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/ceca9a0a4dc7b03de06107785d91cc8d196a7a72.png[/img]
There are also other different Seed of Heat that brings you unique powers and they will be unlocked in following updates. 
[*] [h3]Wills[/h3]
Besides the original power of the Seed of Heart, a Will slot will be unlocked when the Seed of Heart is first upgraded to level 5. From now, you are able to further strengthen your power with Wills. 
There is a small probability for players to get the Fragments of Will by defeating the treasure chests underground. The Fragment of Will can be used to upgrade the Seed of Heart, or be merged into a complete Will in the Furnace of Will. 
By crafting the Furnace of Will, you can get a random Will by merging 5 Fragments of Will together. The Will can be inlayed in your Seed of Heat to provide bonus attributes to your characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/c00122b660e2449542b14475e2670b5e756efee5.png[/img]

[olist]

We adjusted the interfaces displaying basic attributes and only health and thirst is displayed now. 
Hunger is changed into Cold Resistance, which is invisible most of the time. It will only become visible in cold environments. 
Sanity is also invisible now and it only shows up when there’s sanity loss.

1、Interaction is moved to the bottom of the description boxes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/6819e77e92c3ba32b2f5b938583c2d6a43a25696.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[list]
[*][h1]New content: Smoother Actions[/h1]
[olist]

[h3]Christmas is approaching, and we release this month's update as an early gift. In this update we have a very different focus with the previous ones, mainly optimizing the experience of the basic actions and combat scenes, which is expected to bring an unprecedented huge impact on the whole game experience.[/h3]

[*][h2]Smoother Actions[/h2]
[h3]Good News! Your character is now able to run!!![/h3]
Beyond that, the basic actions of the character have been greatly enhanced, your character now is more agile.
The basic actions that have been updated or adjusted include:
1.	Glide Evasion - it was redesigned and re-implemented. New implementation has avoided the sense of lag from swaying back and forth, and is is without CD time. You can do Evasion at any time when or between walking and running, the Rolling action after an Evasion also becomes smoother.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/dc3646868631fc97db4f10b7dc8a4142aa084fcf.gif[/img]
2.	Sprint Dash - long press the Evasion button, you can enter into  a Sprint Dash mode after the Glide Evasion action, in which you  are running faster. This function makes you more flexible whether you are quickly moving or fighting, and some weapons will have special attacking effects during the Sprint Dash mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/11959e00c3851f1dde951b4820fb36c1b46234e2.gif[/img]
3.	Swimming Dash - do you still have the bad memory of swimming slowly in the water? Now what you need is simply clicking the Evasion button, then you will enter the Swimming Dash mode. You can swim a long distance in a minute, helping you swiftly get rid of the awkward situation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/8c8ce48d44f4798fa9c6a864abc847885e07e1f0.gif[/img]
In addition to these three new actions, we also adjusted some actions’ performance effects, including some details -- when you turn sharply or suddenly stop during a running Evasion, for example, there will be sharp stop effects, to improve the gaming experience.
[*][h2]Weapon Master[/h2]
We have improved the experience of melee weapons by redesigning the attack skills of heavy weapons(such as Wooden Stick) and adjusting some of combat skills of Spear.
Now melee weapons have more skills, with many starting skill added.
When a player begin to attack, different skills will be applied, depending on the current speed and status, such as standing, running and sprinting. Meanwhile, these starting skills can also be applied into the combos.
Heavy weapons now have a charge attack mode. Long press the button can trigger the charge attack and different charge attacks will be applied according to your current status like standing, walking, running and dodging. Charge attacks are more powerful than normal attack with a larger range.
You can also preform a jump attack with heavy weapons which has more powerful effects, helping you paralyze your enemies more easily.
The spear's attacks have also been adjusted with optimized actions. The related actions are more reasonable now, the moving range during a combo is reduced. With the newly added Evasion, the battle will be more controllable and easy to operate.
The speeds of the arrow, both starting speed and flying speed, are increased, to improve the hit rate.

[h2]The Halloween event is over, but the Christmas event is coming.[/h2]
[*][h2]Christmas Memories[/h2]

By using "Christmas Memories", you can obtain some imaginations and the memories special for Christmas items.
Don't use all the "Christmas memories" in a reckless way, they are key materials for making Christmas items.
[*][h2]Christmas Tree[/h2]
Christmas tree is a indispensable part of the Christmas season. By cutting down a pine tree, you have a chance to get new item: Large Pine Branch. Although you can plant Large Pine Branch directly on the ground, it has an important role -- to make Christmas tree with other materials such as Christmas Memories.
In the world of dreams, Christmas Tree are not just decoration, they can turn something items into "Christmas memory". By putting Christmas Memories into a Christmas Tree, you can get the magical "Gift Box".

The Christmas Tree and Super Christmas Tree can produce Gift Box and Grand Gift Box. You can put them on the ground and "destroy" them. This will open the boxes and you will get random items as gifts.

We will add some new directions for animals to evolve.

tags.feature: Your character is now able to run!!!

Glide Evasion - it was redesigned and re-implemented. New implementation has avoided the sense of lag from swaying back and forth, and is is without CD time. You can do Evasion at any time when or between walking and running, the Rolling action after an Evasion also becomes smoother.

Sprint Dash - long press the Evasion button, you can enter into a Sprint Dash mode after the Glide Evasion action, in which you are running faster. This function makes you more flexible whether you are quickly moving or fighting, and some weapons will have special attacking effects during the Sprint Dash mode.

Swimming Dash - do you still have the bad memory of swimming slowly in the water? Now what you need is simply clicking the Evasion button, then you will enter the Swimming Dash mode. You can swim a long distance in a minute, helping you swiftly get rid of the awkward situation.

This version will modify the original opening animation, the new opening animation is more exciting, full of details, and hidden worldview related hints.
The new opening animation update will be set a few days later.

[h2][b]Adjust[/b][/h2]

1.The unlock value is adjusted to significantly reduce the amount of imagination required to understand the lock memory, depending on how important the memory is.
2.Improved rate of fertilization in fields, increased effective time of fertilization, and improved harvest rate in fields, grinders and weaving mills.
3.Among the giant vegetables the Immortal flesh has been changed to cactus meat, and the amount of imagination gained has been reduced.
4.Cloth clothes, Cloth hat, Iron Helmet,Iron Armor, Stone Armor, and Stone Helmet will now be unlocked by default.
5.The early production game flow was adjusted to further reduce the early difficulty.
6.Craft Beer was changed to Power Soda, and Strong Spirits was changed to Super power Soda. (We thought it would be better if there were no alcohol.)
7."Marker Flag" became "Memory Flag," "Awesome" became "biscuits," and "Computer Accessories" became "Strange Potion."
8.cloth backpack and Feather Backpack have been increased to 10 slots.
9.The capacity of the simple grinder is changed to 5 grids, and the capacity of the large grinder is increased to 15 grids.
10.Ordinary stones can be placed in the furnace to burn lime, and there is a small probability of burning stone bricks.

[h2][b]Optimization & problem fixing[/b][/h2]

1.Fixed abnormal tyrannosaurus attack judgment.
2.Fixed a problem with cows not producing milk.Now you can make  the  ornate cake to get a lot of imagination.
3.Fixed an issue that recipes could be unlocked but still appear to require imagination.
4.Fixed issue that people or animals sometimes die for no  reason.
5.Fixed grass frame out of sync and collapse crash.
6.Repair building or device interaction anomalies.
7.Vistas will no longer be clipped to lower the screen quality.
8.Stone attach  stone bonfires and seeds attach fields or flowerpot have been made easier.
9.Players will no longer stay in the world for long periods of time after logging off.
10.Optimized client performance, now less graphics card requirements, reduced memory usage, subsequent releases will continue to be multiple rounds of optimization.
11.Greatly optimize the server, reduce synchronization lag.

There will be new events in the next month, and the normal game system will be further improved.

Combat and operations will also be tweaked and optimized.

notes.title: Halloween Announcement
notes.content:
[h1][b]Halloween [/b][/h1]

Last month, The English version that many players have requested is finally here. 
This month we will start our first event , Halloween Activity!
Halloween activity will add many Halloween-specific items, the world environment will also be changed, there are also a number of Halloween-only recipes, you can get more items than usual.

[h2]Halloween memories[/h2]
Cut down a tree, dig a mine, or defeat a scarier-looking creature during the Halloween event, and you have the chance to earn a "Halloween memory."
Use "Halloween Memories" to get imagination and memories about some Halloween-specific items.
Don't use all of your "Halloween memories" at once. "Halloween memories" are also one of the materials used to make Halloween-specific items.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/2cb0a46bf45320cc3052100d186d9d3b3eaa59b7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/c4b5ad7bb2e186c434552a9b91d197c39ae777b6.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Ritual birdbath[/h2]

The  ritual birdbath is the centerpiece of Halloween , and you will get the memory of the ritual birdbath  during Halloween. The ritual birdbath can turn something that has Halloween feel into "Halloween memories" and "holiday candies". It also can make  "Halloween memories" into all kinds of things. This magic has what kind of magic effect also needs to be experienced in the game.
The ritual birdbath has other magic you can explore by yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/3f8ac848d58f28d62dcc13fd15dff1e9d31fabc5.png[/img]

[h2]Holiday candy[/h2]

There is a high probability that you will receive a certain amount of holiday candy while using the Ritual birdbath. Acacia trees also have a chance to drop large candy canes, which can be used as sticks to stun animals.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/560e966f813c1695f3a0a46a3f70656166cd13b9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/c52303b82af23d6496ef42d57644d550a5bf707e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Pumpkins for Halloween[/h2]

Pumpkins play an important role in Halloween, of course.
During Halloween growing pumpkins has a  probability of producing  large pumpkins. Oversized pumpkins can be decorated directly in your home, or you can choose to smash it and get lots of smaller pumpkins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/cb34543ba7cf9fcf26266e1648da273ad87ee217.png[/img]
At the same time, the addition of jack-o '-lanterns and pumpkin houses made of giant pumpkins during Halloween can fill your home with holiday spirit. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/3dc17275411ea1b32909b829743f06eb1be23f76.png[/img]
Gunpowder can be added to the pumpkin to make a powerful pumpkin bomb, making your survival and adventure more convenient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/124849a144711304f0cd33295d6fedf16b1199c1.png[/img]

[h2]Halloween costumes[/h2]

Added some of the fun Halloween style costumes, Blend in better during the festival!
[h3]1. Ghost cape
2. Creepy wings
3. Fairy wings

notes.content:
[list]
[*][h1]New Content: Dreaming[/h1]
Latest version is coming as promised.
This update has added new equipment of animals and people, which has greatly optimized the overall experience details. More importantly, the English and traditional editions will be available here.

Moose are found in the snowfield. They’re tall and have good fighting and transport capability. Defeating the moose will offer you a lot of animal horns.

1. Woolen Coat

According to the new production system, we’ve greatly adjusted the production-related property values, balanced item values and imagination points acquisition, and unlocked memory consumption, etc.

In this release, cooking food will be the main way to get daily meals and gain imagination points, by expanding your farm and ranch and making all kinds of delicious food, you can gain imagination points and recover your attributes.

Due to the increased complexity of the craft, the true value of many later-stage items has significantly enlarged, so the consumption of imagination points has also increased.

Therefore, the amount of imagination points gained and consumed in this release has increased tremendously, and the visible property values will become larger.

[/list]
[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
1. The energy-gathering substance is now called limpid grease. It can be acquired through the decomposition of black grease in the burning furnace.
2. Obtaining seeds will be harder. Most of the seeds will not be obtained through squirrels, instead, they’ll be distributed in various places.
3. The machine tool model has been changed to the original blacksmith table, and the new machine tool can’t have power from the generator directly. It needs to be driven by installing chemical batteries in it.
4. Some of the original food positions have changed. The food serves different functions for animals from the original version.  
5. Among the original foods, Coconut Eggplant, Fish-flavored Pork, Solid Food and Military Solid Food can no longer be crafted.

[h1]Optimization & Issue Fixes[/h1]
1. The water effect and raindrop effect are fixed.
2. When you press the P button quickly, the memory interface will not be stuck anymore.
3. The animals can jump over long distances now.
4. The problem of the abnormal judgment of several skills is fixed.
[h1]Upcoming Updates[/h1]
In the next release, we will optimize various experience issues in this release, the last part of the industrial era under the current production system, the displayed UI, and the combat-related property values. We’ll add many new characters animals and equipment, etc. The game experience will be more perfect.

At the same time, we’re making the mega expansion pack Floating Island through intense work. Now, we’ve completed half of it. When the sandbox system is stable, we will offer it to players step by step, so please stay tuned.

We'll be releasing the official update this month, but we need some time to make sure it's stable before then, so we'll keep an eye out for issues and release small updates in the meantime.

[h2]Last, we’ve put our best efforts into the translation of the [b][u]English[/u][/b] version and we plan to open the [u][b]European server[/b][/u] test [u][b]next month[/b][/u].[/h2]

notes.content:
[list]
[*][h2]New Content: Settler's Craft[/h2]
Since last update, one month has passed. And the new update is now available on schedule(Yes, we make it!). In this update, we mainly modified the production system which is needed when players experienced the camping stage and are preparing for the Iron Age.

Many new features have been added in this vision, such as weapon recycle, planting mechanism optimization and the new usage of some materials. We also added a kind of new core material - “Clay” - and some new items that rely on it.

In addition, the new content in Floating Island is busily made advancing on a tight schedule, and is expected to be released in the near future.

[olist]

[*][h3]Settlement Craft[/h3]
In this update, we focus on the adjustment of the production system that is important for players who have finished the comping stage and are ready for the Iron Age. Two kinds of workbenches were added: Manual Workbench and Reaction Tank. The manufacture of some items will have to use these two new tools.

Two new core materials were introduced: Clay and Animal Skin. They have been integrated into our new production system. We also added some new primary equipment.

[*][h3]Weapon Recycle[/h3]
We added a new Weapon Recycle feature that works on most of the current weapons. Metal weapons can now be put into a furnace to recycle a proportion of metal, while wood-and-stone weapons can be put into a fire to recycle the stone parts.
[*][h3]Planting Optimization[/h3]
he old planting system has been totally redesigned. The farming mechanism now is different from the previous factory-styled production process. Under the new planting system, you first drag the seeds into the field, then add some fertilizers (for example, shit), and the seeds will grow and bear fruit automatically.

The crops need fertilizers to grow. That is to say, you can harvest more than one time as long as there is enough fertilizer. When there is not enough fertilizer, however, the crops will stop growing.

[*][h3]Some items can be used with hand[/h3]
This is a interesting feature! You can now hold an items and use it in special ways. You can throw it or wave it as a weapon to attack or harass your enemies.

Items that can be thrown include:
1.	Stone
2.	Big Stone
3.	Stone Brick
4.	Shit
5.	Super Shit

There are also some items that you can use as weapons, though their performance is not as powerful as the true weapons.
This kind of items include:
1.	Branch
2.	Quality Meat

[*][h3]Equipment For Newbies[/h3]
We have added several cheap equipment to help the novice players survive the battles and life on the early stage, and adjusted some property values of the existing items.
New equipment designed for beginners include：
1.	Humble Wooden Armour[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/bf9c4da15ec248df0cee109065646c3cecf89bd6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/e286003d7dc934d902ea7ddf24b5f969149f40b7.png[/img][/url]
2.	Humble Leather Jacket[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/0cc87232a8028d8b03620c5982febc902475d654.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/a2c26c6ea176e1a269b5f975e92e911824f9f11e.png[/img][/url]
3.	Coconut Helmet[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/2ff4d6e521d68a106a5ce07a46a46469f70f134d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/f57045dc0e2ad9d32dde2513e92c2e80c80eb10b.png[/img][/url]
4.	Leather Bag[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/a75dbca5e4762237c540c5dd119444f0a4443011.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/7b6bcff6dfd72a15b02ef8a0271e9f522bec31e9.png[/img][/url]

[*][h3]New On-the-ground Items[/h3]
Several new on-the-ground Items were added in this release. A new kind of material - Clay - was introduced, as well as new ways to gather grass. New on-the-ground Items include:
1.	Clay Pile(Small)
2.	Clay Pile(Middle)
3.	Clay Pile(Large)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/002d0f09c2be74ea82505e1f836a68c73ce17947.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/46c6016ad97020c348ab429db0a3a76a71d930bb.png[/img][/url]
4.	Reed[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/bc0429dd1126f1f41285401a69cd8b4f23366e8f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985956/be4659013ca0ce9eea87a01b0418a31e6e089281.png[/img][/url]

Note: Reed and High Grass need Sword or Scythe to gather.
[/olist]
[*][h2]Adjustments[/h2]
1.	Now the Berry Bushes can only be planted in the fields. Good news is they can grow without fertilization. The Berry Bushes that have already been planted on the ground by players can still grow, but players can no longer plant new Berry Bushes on the ground.
2.	All planting-related functions have been transferred to new planting system.
[*][h2]Optimization & Issue Fixes[/h2]
1.	Optimized the server delay problem. Now there is no delay when you switch between the domains.
2.	When you press E, items that can be put away will no longer be put away directly.
3.	Fixed some server stability issues.
4.	Improved FPS of the game.
[*][h2]About the updates in the future[/h2]
This time we successfully achieve the goal of monthly update, and we will try to maintain this pace in the future.

In the following updates, we will continue to optimize the gaming experience and production system. Meanwhile, we will develop some new features and playing methods. The new content of Floating Island is under working at full speed.

In the next update, we may bring some new contents of the Iron Age, including new process system, new decorations, new creatures, new foods, moving objects by hand, repairing weapons and many more.
[/list]

In the future, we may use the monthly server as a lab, introducing some experimental monthly activities and new playing methods.

[*][h2]New contents: Traveler's Shelter[/h2]
Six months have passed since our last update. How time flies! During that time we were busy with our new content: Floating Island. As the playing mechanics in Floating Island is pretty different from the current sandbox system and need a good deal of work, we had to spent much more time on it. And we sincerely apologize for this. (So we broke our promise, anyway.)

This update is still based on the existing game contents and around the traveler's campground, adding a whole set of items and foods related to the camping life. In addition, we significantly optimized the early stage process and adjusted some quests to offer our players better experience. The update also comes with some adjustments and bug fixes.

[*][h3]Camping Life[/h3]
In Camping Life, a player can quickly build a fully functional temporary camp with convenient materials, living in a temporary tent, facing the campfire, and sleeping sound in the scent of nature. [*][h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Adjusted the early stage quests to focus on camping life; reduced the difficulty of the quests and significantly increased the early stage rewards.
[*]Stone pickaxe was changed to horn pickaxe, which needs to be made with Horn Materials.
[*]Animal Bone was renamed to Horn Material, representing animal horns and beaks, etc.
[*]Rubble was renamed to Huge Stone, used for advanced buildings and advanced stone tools.
[*]Seeds are foods now.
[*]Basic items, such as bonfire, weaving mill and rope, now need less materials.
[/olist]
[*][h2]Optimization & Issue Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Adjusted lighting and materials, bringing higher quality game screens.
[*]Fixed many and many problems (and introduced lots of new issues, maybe).
[*]Improved all basic operations of characters.
[/olist]
[*][h2]About the updates in the future[/h2]
From now on, we will simultaneously advance the Floating Island and the original contents, and come back into a state of frequent updates (maybe), no longer with a delay of six months(hope so).

Subsequent updates will depend on the feedback from this update. We will gradually optimize the game according to players‘s experience at different stages, constantly adding corresponding items to enrich players’ survival experience at each stage.

On top of this, we will add a lot of new items and new playing methods. A new type of basic material - Clay - will be added, as well as other clay-related items. 

In the future, you will be able to plant trees, store water with items, or use small traps to catch animals. There also will be many changes in the combat system and operations. Just look forward to them!

PS Don't rush, I swear that we are busy making them. (New -> New Folder)

[*][h2]There is something serious that the producer wants to add in the end.[/h2]
I think it's necessary to explain what takes us so long to update. When this game went live on STEAM EA in the middle of last year, there were only 2 staff in our team, and we met a lot of problems at the beginning. We tried our best to deal with them and fix bugs, and have completed a lot of iterations.

For us, each update means working around the clock for several days. We felt more or less powerless during the process, and more importantly, we don’t have enough time to solve many problems concerning the players’ experience. 

This problem was exacerbated by the content production of Floating Island. At the beginning, we thought we could finish the content production of Floating Island in 2 months, but as you can see, though we’ve tried a lot of directions, the quality never meets our expectations.

I think we should stop working and think about how we can bring an essential change to the current dilemma.

So, in the past few months, we spent a lot of time on improving the production capacity, and it’s worthwhile from it looks now. We got significant support from some partners who share a common goal. Now, our team has gradually taken shape (small and warm).

Though we’ve wasted some time, I believe that we can polish up the game in a steady way in the future. Thank you so much for your constant attention (urging us to update).

[h3]In the time to come, we will work in 3 aspects:[/h3]

[olist]
[*]The optimization of the game and players’ experience. New quest lines, a lot of new items, creatures, and game mechanics will be provided. We’ll keep updating in this aspect (aperiodically).
[*]Super big epic update packages, such as Floating Island. I hope these packages will bring you a completely different experience. Because of our lack of production capacity in the early stage, the launch of Floating Island was long delayed, and perhaps we still need more time to make the preparation. But now we have a clear plan and expectations on its quality.
[*]The integration of multiple devices and multiple regions. It has always been our dream to make global players play “Zero-based World” on mobile devices. Our progress was stagnating due to our lack of production capacity before, but I believe we can put more effort to realize it in the future.
[/olist]
In a word, we will try our utmost to finish what we have started (New -> New Folder, again), so please don’t urge us anymore.
[/list]
